the fluorescence intensity of Cu-ZSM5 depends on the composition of a gas containing oxygen and a reductant and that the intensity correlates with the oxygen concentration for weakly reducing gases and with the reductants-to-oxygen concentration ratio for strongly reducing gases.

Cu-ZSM- 5 zeolites exhibit a strong fluorescence response to the presence of oxygen and to the presence of reductants, and that this fluorescence response provides a mechanism for a sensor of gas composition.
Cu-ZSM- 5 zeolites can serve as a basis for an optical sensor for the detection of O(2), and the sensor signal depends on the gas composition.

the development of an optical fiber gas sensing system based on the luminescence of Cu-ZSM5 zeolite.
the development of an optical fiber sensor based upon fluorescence quenching.
the development of an optical sensor for oxygen concentration and gas composition.
